senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָמֵשׁ)fifth; (sub. יום) the fifth day of the week.
units: Meg. I, 2, sq.; a. fr.—Fem. חֲמִישִׁית.
Ib. III, 4 בח׳ on the fifth Sabbath; a. fr.—Esp. (Lev. V, 24) the penalty of the fifth part added to the indemnity.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 65b:6">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>חֲמִשִׁתָיו</he>, Lev. l. c.) <he>ח׳ הרבה וכ׳</he> (ed. <cite ref="H01234"><he>חֲמִשִׁ׳</he></cite>) repeated penalties connected with one object of indemnity.
